game.title: Lords of the Fallen
game.blurb: Dark-fantasy action RPG where you cross between the living world of Axiom and the Umbral realm of the dead, from Hexworks, released 2023-10-13. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Journey and the Bosses
chapters.summary: The journey across Mournestead, its bosses and its endings, from the first trip to Skyrest Bridge onward. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Axiom, Umbral and First Steps
chapters.summary: Dying and coming back, Vestige Seeds, Umbral finishers, the Umbral lamp and its Umbral Eyes, stigmas and offerings.

chapters.title: Gear, Runes and Levels
chapters.summary: Upgrading weapons and the Sanguinarix, socketing runes, applying tincts and reaching level 100.

chapters.title: Full Collections
chapters.summary: Every area, weapon, armour piece, ring, spell, throwable, ammo type and gesture, and every achievement.

chapters.title: Co-op and PvP
chapters.summary: Beckoning a co-op partner, beating bosses together, avenging other lampbearers and player-versus-player fights. Needs online play.

chapters.title: New Game Modifiers
chapters.summary: Starting new games with modifiers and reaching an ending with pairs of them switched on.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2023 game (RAWG "lords-of-the-fallen-2", id 840776), not the 2014 one; Steam app 1501750 is "Lords of the Fallen" (app 265300 is the 2014 game). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Lords of the Fallen (2023)" as a stub (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and Achievements subpages, but only "Achievements and trophies" and "Table of Contents" exist, so nothing was used. lordsofthefallen.fandom.com answers under "Lords of the Fallen (2023)", with about 12 linked articles (such as "Adyr", "Axiom", "Mournestead", "Umbral"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "The Lords of the Fallen". 34 of 77 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the journey chapter, though the last few (very low unlock rates, such as "Adyr's Chosen" at 0.8%) are probably endings or late optional bosses. "The Past Shapes the Present" (offering Molhu the Bowl of Revelations) and "A Rest Among the Dead" (reaching the Skyrest Bridge interior) are put with the journey. The eight modifier-ending achievements have their own chapter.
